reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Figma Make (https://www.figma.com/make/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 浅色页面，正中先出现 Figma Make 的图标和一句「Prototype. Polish. Ship. Your ideas get real in Figma Make.」，底部压着一条绿色横幅，写着 AI add-ons now come with 2x more credits on Professional。往下分三块 Design and ship / Build prototypes with context / Move fluidly between design and code，feature 列表里能看到 Make on your local codebase (Beta)、Custom skills、MCP connectors，社区示例摆了 Travel App Prototype 和 Climate Dashboard。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
